encounters.cc: Heavy vaginal bleeding for two days, three weeks after vaginal delivery

lines: Heavy vaginal bleeding for two days, three weeks after vaginal delivery
She gave birth to a healthy baby boy vaginally 3 weeks ago.
The delivery was complicated by a small retained placental fragment, which was manually removed in the delivery room.
Her postpartum course was uneventful, and she was discharged home in good condition.
- Manual extraction of retained placental fragments
- Alprazolam 0.25 mg PO PRN anxiety (occasional use)
She denies any fever, abdominal pain, or foul-smelling discharge.
Speculum examination reveals active bleeding from the cervical os.
The uterus is firm and non-tender on bimanual examination.
Transvaginal ultrasound shows a 1.5 cm echogenic mass within the uterine cavity.

encounters.cc: Persistent worry about newborn's health and safety at 6 weeks postpartum

lines: Persistent worry about newborn's health and safety at 6 weeks postpartum

This 32-year-old woman with generalized anxiety disorder, obsessive-compulsive disorder, myasthenia gravis, bruxism, and temporomandibular joint disorder presents to psychiatry at six weeks postpartum following an emergency department evaluation one month ago for heavy vaginal bleeding.
She presents with complaints of persistent worry about her newborn's health and safety.
She reports feeling on edge, having difficulty concentrating, and experiencing muscle tension.
She is sleeping poorly and often wakes up feeling restless.
She denies any thoughts of harming herself or her baby.
She expresses concern that her anxiety is interfering with her ability to care for her baby and her enjoyment of motherhood.
- Secondary postpartum hemorrhage due to retained products of conception (diagnosed 2020-01-15)
- Manual extraction of retained placental fragments
- Alprazolam 0.25 mg PO PRN anxiety (occasional use)
Her vital signs are within normal limits
- Complete blood count: within normal limits

encounters.cc: Intrusive thoughts about contaminating newborn and compulsive washing behaviors

lines: Intrusive thoughts about contaminating newborn and compulsive washing behaviors

The patient is a 32-year-old female with myasthenia gravis and anxiety disorders who presents six weeks postpartum following ED treatment for postpartum hemorrhage and an earlier psychiatry visit today for persistent worry regarding her newborn.
She reports an overwhelming fear that she might accidentally contaminate her baby with germs, leading to serious illness.
Despite recognizing these fears as irrational, she feels compelled to wash her hands and sterilize the baby's bottles and toys excessively, often repeating the process multiple times a day.
This behavior is significantly interfering with her ability to care for her child and her own sleep.
- Secondary postpartum hemorrhage due to retained products of conception (diagnosed 2020-01-15)
She has a history of mild anxiety but has never experienced symptoms to this extent.
Her pregnancy was uncomplicated, and she has no other medical issues.
- Manual extraction of retained placental fragments
- Alprazolam 0.25 mg PO PRN anxiety (occasional use)
Her vital signs are within normal limits,
On examination, she appears restless and admits to feeling 'on edge' most of the time.
and the rest of the physical examination is unremarkable.

encounters.cc: Intermittent double vision and difficulty keeping eyes open, worse at end of day

lines: Intermittent double vision and difficulty keeping eyes open, worse at end of day

The patient returns to Neurology clinic for follow-up of known myasthenia gravis in the context of recent postpartum hemorrhage and concurrent psychiatric evaluations for generalized anxiety disorder and obsessive-compulsive disorder.
She presents with a 3-month history of intermittent double vision and difficulty keeping her eyes open, especially towards the end of the day.
She reports that her symptoms seem to improve after resting.
She gave birth to her first child 6 weeks ago and has been experiencing increasing difficulty holding her baby due to arm weakness.
She also mentions occasional difficulty swallowing.
- Secondary postpartum hemorrhage due to retained products of conception (diagnosed 2020-01-15)
- Manual extraction of retained placental fragments
- Alprazolam 0.25 mg PO PRN anxiety (occasional use)
On examination, you note bilateral ptosis that worsens after sustained upward gaze and mild bilateral facial weakness.
Repetitive nerve stimulation shows a decremental response.

encounters.cc: Palpitations, irritability, and unintentional weight loss at 4 months postpartum

lines: Palpitations, irritability, and unintentional weight loss at 4 months postpartum

This 32-year-old female, who is four months postpartum and has recent encounters for secondary postpartum hemorrhage, intermittent double vision, and intrusive thoughts with compulsive washing, presents with palpitations, irritability, and unintentional weight loss.
She denies any heat intolerance or diarrhea.
- Secondary postpartum hemorrhage due to retained products of conception (diagnosed 2020-01-15)
Her past medical history is significant for gestational diabetes, which was diet-controlled and resolved after delivery.
- Manual extraction of retained placental fragments
- Alprazolam 0.25 mg PO PRN anxiety (occasional use)
She has no personal or family history of thyroid disease.
On examination, her heart rate is 102 beats per minute, blood pressure is 130/85 mmHg
, and she has a fine tremor on outstretched hands.
There is no goiter or thyroid nodules palpable.
Her skin is warm and moist.
- Erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR): 20 mm/hr (normal range: 0-20 mm/hr)

encounters.cc: Noticeable increase in hair shedding over past three months

lines: Noticeable increase in hair shedding over past three months

The patient presents for dermatology evaluation with history of recent postpartum thyroiditis and secondary postpartum hemorrhage, receiving ongoing psychiatric care for generalized anxiety disorder and obsessive-compulsive disorder.
She reports that she gave birth to her first child six months ago and describes the period following delivery as "extremely stressful" due to complications requiring a prolonged hospital stay.
She denies any scalp itching, pain, or rash.
She has not used any new hair products or medications recently.
- Secondary postpartum hemorrhage due to retained products of conception (diagnosed 2020-01-15)
- Manual extraction of retained placental fragments
- Alprazolam 0.25 mg PO PRN anxiety (occasional use)
On examination, her scalp appears normal without erythema, scaling, or scarring.
Hair pull test shows increased shedding, but the hair shafts are normal without breakage or tapering.
No other abnormalities are noted on physical examination.
Her complete blood count, thyroid function tests, and serum ferritin level are within normal limits.

encounters.cc: Six-month history of intermittent headaches and jaw pain with morning worsening

lines: Six-month history of intermittent headaches and jaw pain with morning worsening
The patient returns to Neurology for evaluation of jaw symptoms, in the context of her Myasthenia gravis and anxiety disorders.
She reports that the pain is worse in the morning and sometimes radiates to her ear.
She also experiences a clicking sound when opening her mouth wide and occasional jaw locking.
She denies any recent dental procedures or facial trauma.
- Secondary postpartum hemorrhage due to retained products of conception (diagnosed 2020-01-15)
Her medical history is significant for anxiety and bruxism.
- Manual extraction of retained placental fragments
- Alprazolam 0.25 mg PO PRN anxiety (occasional use)
On physical examination, there is tenderness to palpation over the masseter and temporalis muscles.
The temporomandibular joint (TMJ) is tender, and a click is audible upon opening her jaw.
There is no erythema or warmth over the joint.

lines: Found lethargic and minimally responsive at home after taking anxiety medication

She is brought to the emergency department by her friends after they found her lethargic and minimally responsive at home.
They report that she has been under significant stress at work and has a history of anxiety for which she occasionally takes alprazolam.
